internet.heading: The Internet
internet.subheading: A short history, and why I love it.
points: 1969: ARPANET sends its first message between two computers.
1991: Tim Berners-Lee publishes the first website.
1996: My first encounter with the Internet. In an Internet café in Dublin.
Today: billions of people, connected in real time.
Why I love it: anyone, anywhere, can build something and put it in front of the world.

studioFi.heading: Studio Fi
points: Building websites in three languages: Irish, English, and German.
Customer-focused, fast response times, and clever solutions.
Giving people a space to control their own corner of the internet — away from rigid WordPress templates.

clients.heading: Who I've Built For
clients.subheading: A few of the people and projects I've built for.

spvg.name: SpVg Hagen Hardissen
spvg.description: Club website for a local football association in Hagen-Hardissen, Germany. News, fixtures, and squad pages.
spvg.highlight: CMS-driven news & fixtures for a community football club

schoner.name: Schöner Moment
schoner.description: Business card website for a local care service in Lage, Germany, supporting mainly elderly residents. Warm, elegant design with beautiful animations.
schoner.highlight: Animated business card site for a local care service in Lage

mittt.name: M.I.T.T.T.
mittt.description: Comprehensive platform for a dog therapy training institute in Germany. Booking system, online shop, blog, newsletter, and community — a true all-in-one website.
mittt.highlight: All-in-one platform for a dog therapy training institute — booking, shop, blog, newsletter & community

restory.name: Re:Story
restory.description: Multilingual e-commerce website for Re:Story, a shop in Limerick city centre selling local arts and crafts. Customers can browse and order products through a unique email-based ordering system.
restory.highlight: Multilingual arts & crafts shop in Limerick with a unique email ordering system

treestory.name: Tree Story
treestory.description: Website for Tree Story, a local forest in Ireland that welcomes people of all ages to explore and enjoy nature. Features a blog with stories, guides, and seasonal updates from the forest.
treestory.highlight: Nature-first website with a blog for a local Irish forest open to all ages

wemakespace.name: We Make Space
wemakespace.description: Website for We Make Space, a company offering beautifully designed modular garden spaces built from steel. Clean, architectural aesthetic showcasing their bespoke outdoor structures and the many ways to bring one home.
wemakespace.highlight: Sleek product showcase for a modular steel garden space company

bredinnaboinne.name: Bréidín na Bóinne
bredinnaboinne.description: Website for Bréidín na Bóinne, a weaver based in Ráth Chairn, Co. Meath, with a monthly content plan and email enquiries for opening times and purchases.
bredinnaboinne.highlight: Monthly-updated craft site for a Ráth Chairn weaver, with email-based enquiries

clononycastle.name: Clonony Castle
clononycastle.description: Heritage history website for Clonony Castle, telling the story of the castle and its history. Came through a referral from Fionán at Re:Story.
clononycastle.highlight: Heritage storytelling site for a historic Irish castle

rathchairn.name: Ráth Chairn
rathchairn.description: Platform for Ráth Chairn, a local Irish-speaking Gaeltacht area, telling its history and offering events and classes with login and course purchasing. Not yet live.
rathchairn.highlight: Login-gated platform for the Ráth Chairn Gaeltacht — history, events & course sales
